# The ball: an icosahedron 0.2 m in radius (exaggerated: 6 art pixels across in the scene),
# white with dark patches so its roll shows. Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Ball --base-color 1.000 1.000 1.000 --no-slot
material new Patch --base-color 0.133 0.165 0.361 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0 0 0
material assign Ball
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.75 || normal.z < -0.75 || normal.x > 0.85 || normal.x < -0.85"
material assign Patch
mode object
shade flat
export ball.glb
